reason: The hypothesis cites no prior evidence, and all key premises—film formation, disruption/reformation kinetics, accelerated corrosion of exposed substrate, and the synergistic feedback loop—are specific claims about HEA behavior under tribo-corrosion that require experimental support. No cited passages are provided to substantiate any of these premises.
premises: A protective, multi-component passive film forms on HEAs and can self-heal
Mechanical wear can breach this passive film faster than it reforms
Freshly exposed alloy corrodes more rapidly than the film-covered surface
Corrosion-induced surface changes exacerbate mechanical wear, creating a feedback loop
The synergy leads to degradation greater than the sum of isolated wear and corrosion
